architecture_contract.indexed_operations: Gather and scatter apply the packing rule to the index payload value and execute duplicate lanes in row-major order after instruction-wide preflight.
architecture_contract.events: Each four-bit logical lane emits one byte-sized memory event over the containing byte.
architecture_contract.preflight: The complete containing-byte footprint is probed before payload, memory, event, or reservation effects.
architecture_contract.gmov: Core4 peer source is resolved before the one-level direct-operation carrier; GMOV copies that read-old fragment to the compatible local destination.

test_scenarios: FP4, FPL4, S4, and U4 packed TLOAD/MGATHER zero-extension plus TSTORE sibling preservation
packed TSTORE sibling-nibble preservation and odd-tail preservation
GMOV resolved-peer fragment payload and definedness copy
first, middle, and last containing-byte TLOAD and TSTORE faults
first, middle, and last indexed-lane gather, scatter, and TPREFETCH preflight with no partial effects
successful TLOAD restart after repaired footprint
